verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance's Entity Manager is documented as displaying registrations, statuses and key data. It is also described as visualizing each entity's registrations on a map, identifying registrations across states, monitoring entity statuses, and showing due dates and filing status. Together these cover entities, state registrations, standing and deadlines. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that all of this appears in one unified dashboard, deadline visibility beyond annual reports, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, one dashboard shows every entity and state registration with its standing and upcoming deadlines

citations.quote: Entity Manager automatically displays your registrations, statuses, and key data
Visualize your registrations for each entity on an interactive map.
See due dates, filing status, approved documents, and more.
Identify registrations across states, monitor entity statuses, and receive precise annual report reminders customizable by user.
